description: Shows Claude Code context-window usage and session tokens in the VS Code status bar, read from local Claude Code transcripts.
config.enabled: Show Claude Code usage in the status bar.
config.sessionScope: Which Claude Code session to follow.
config.sessionScope.workspace: The newest session started in an open workspace folder (falls back to the newest overall).
config.sessionScope.latest: The newest session of any project.
config.statusFormat: Status bar text. Placeholders: `{percent}` `{context}` `{window}` `{model}` `{session}` `{output}` `{cost}`. Codicons such as `$(pulse)` are allowed.
config.contextWindow: Context window size in tokens, or `auto` (1,000,000 for 1M-context models or when usage already exceeds 200,000; otherwise 200,000).
config.warningThreshold: Context percentage that turns the item yellow.
config.errorThreshold: Context percentage that turns the item red.
config.refreshIntervalSeconds: How often to check the transcript, in seconds.
config.pricing: Optional prices in USD per million tokens, keyed by model-id prefix, e.g. `{ "claude-opus": { "input": 0, "output": 0, "cacheRead": 0, "cacheWrite": 0 } }`. Empty = no cost is shown. Results are estimates only.
